tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream by day, cocoa-black by night — never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that sits on top of the page: cards, window panels, the nav bar, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells — footer band, code blocks, the strip behind a tag rail or a marquee.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — captions, bylines, timestamps, the category on a recipe row — on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between list rows and inside panels, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The chunky 2–3px border drawn around every button, card, window and control. The single most identity-carrying token in the system.

tokens.name: hotpink
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: links, the active nav item, primary button fill, headline accents. Safe as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: hotpink-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled or coloured hotpink.

tokens.name: hotpink-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind pink content — selected tags, highlighted rows, the pink half of a gradient block.

tokens.name: on-hotpink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a hotpink or hotpink-strong fill.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Bright orange FILL: secondary buttons, colour blocks, starbursts, the marquee rail. Not for text on surface — use orange-deep.

tokens.name: orange-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an orange fill.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Orange as TEXT — section eyebrows, secondary links — on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind orange content: callouts, the hovered state of a list row.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange or orange-strong fill — dark in both themes, because the fill stays bright in both.

tokens.name: cocoa
tokens.usage: Brown structural accent: window title bars, table headers, and text on cocoa-soft and orange-soft grounds (on sunshine use on-sunshine).

tokens.name: cocoa-soft
tokens.usage: Brown tint for window title bars, striped table rows and the inside of a bevel.

tokens.name: on-cocoa
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cocoa fill.

tokens.name: sunshine
tokens.usage: Yellow highlighter FILL: the marquee band, starbursts, the 'new' flag, text highlight. Never text itself.

tokens.name: on-sunshine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sunshine fill — dark in both themes.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Retro-future cyan FILL: sparkle glyphs, chrome edges, the accent stripe on a window bar. The Y2K note in an otherwise warm palette.

tokens.name: aqua-deep
tokens.usage: Aqua as TEXT — small meta labels, the counter — on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: aqua-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind aqua content: info callouts, the sparkle field behind a heading.

tokens.name: on-aqua
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an aqua fill — dark in both themes.

tokens.name: visited
tokens.usage: Visited links inside long prose (recipes, notes) on surface and surface-raised — the one purple in the system, kept for the 2003 browser feel.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Ready / done / success: fill, and text on surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word or icon — never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a leaf fill.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Error / cancelled: fill, and text on surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word or icon — it sits close to hotpink in hue, so colour alone will not read.

tokens.name: on-cherry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cherry fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px focus ring on every interactive element. Solid, never dashed, and always drawn with a 2px gap in the element's own ground so the ring lands on surface, surface-raised or surface-sunken rather than on a bright fill.

tokens.name: gloss-hi
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight of a gel button or chrome bevel — an inset shadow, never a background of its own.

tokens.name: gloss-lo
tokens.usage: Inner bottom shade of a gel button or chrome bevel, paired with gloss-hi.

tokens.name: chrome-hi
tokens.usage: Light edge of a bevelled chrome frame — the top and left sides of an inset well.

tokens.name: chrome-lo
tokens.usage: Dark edge of a bevelled chrome frame — the bottom and right sides of an inset well.

styles.name: display-xxl
styles.usage: The name on the home page and the one bouncing headline per page. One per page, never two.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles on recipes, projects and the cafe.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Top heading inside a page body.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Ingredients, Steps, Notes — the big landmarks in a recipe.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Ingredient group headings, card titles, window title bars.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and recipe steps — the reading size when a page is mostly prose.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and list text everywhere.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Ingredient names inside steps, and the emphasised run in a sentence.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card descriptions, helper text under form fields.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Bylines, footnotes, the footer line. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links; the active one goes to fontWeight 700 and hotpink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small all-caps labels and tag text — apply text-transform: uppercase yourself, the token only carries the metrics.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Amounts, quantities and any tabular number — the US/grams readout above all.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Timestamps, order ids, the small print in a window title bar.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: The hit-counter and order-number treatment: mono, wide-tracked, on a sunken well.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Cards and windows pad with space-5; the gap between a page's big blocks is space-7.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's icon and its label; the inner offset of a bevel.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control — button icon to label, segmented-control padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding block; gap between tags in a rail.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List-row padding, gap between form fields, card body padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Standard card, window and page-gutter padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the big blocks of a page; space above the footer.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding on desktop; the breathing room around a display headline.

radius.note: Everything is round. When in doubt, go one step rounder than feels correct.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny chips, inline code, the squares in a bevel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields, the inner well of a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, recipe rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and window panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, the cafe menu board, big colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the segmented control's thumb, starburst centres.

stroke.note: Borders are drawn, not implied. Chunky outlines are what keep the palette from turning into pastel mush.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers in hairline between list rows.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: The default outline on cards, windows, tags and inputs.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, the active nav item, the focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: Hero blocks and the cafe board — the loudest frame in the system.

shadow.note: Two families: a hard offset 'sticker' shadow that does the retro work, and one soft shadow for things that genuinely float.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The default hard shadow on buttons, tags and cards — offset down-right, no blur. Pair with an outline border.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-lg
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, windows and the cafe board.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: The :active state — the element also translates 3px down-right, so it looks physically pushed.

tokens.name: shadow-gel
tokens.usage: The Aqua-era gloss inside a filled button or pill. Always inset, always on top of a flat fill.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The only blurred shadow: popovers, the mobile nav sheet, anything that overlays the page.
